sloka: स भिन्नवर्मा रुधिरं वमन् वक्त्रेण रावणिः।जग्राह कार्मुकश्रेष्ठं दृढज्यं बलवत्तरम् ।। ६.९१.२१ ।।
transliteration: sa bhinnavarmā rudhiraṁ vaman vaktreṇa rāvaṇiḥ।jagrāha kārmukaśreṣṭhaṁ dṛḍhajyaṁ balavattaram ।। 6.91.21 ।।

translations.english: Bow split, ejecting blood from mouth, Indrajith took his strong best of bows which had a stout string.
